# A flow of rich text, as the interpreter holds it.
#
# `none` renders nothing, so what it owes the family is the tree: `sngl test`
# asserts on it and `t.snapshot` prints it, and a document reaching a test as
# the words the author wrote is the whole of what an implementation here means.
# Which is why `codegen/platform/none/none.sngl` declares `flow` and `inline`
# rather than leaving every member an empty body the way the shapes are left:
# a member whose body inserts its content is a component with a body, and a
# snapshot prints a component's expansion rather than the component -- so a
# `run` with a bare body would put its words in the tree and lose the style
# that is the whole of what a run says.
#
# Three things are asserted and each could go wrong elsewhere:
#
#   - The words are literal. The interpreter has no host to collapse
#     whitespace, so the two spaces and the newline are simply the string --
#     and the `<em>` is four characters and not an element, which is what
#     makes html the one target with escaping to do.
#   - Nesting survives. `link { monospace { … } }` is two spans deep, which is
#     what a flattened run list would have lost.
#   - What a member says that its name does not. A run's style, a link's href
#     and a token's kind each reach the tree as a prop.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
exists app.sngl.snapshots/tree.sngl

grep 'flow\(role="paragraph"\)' app.sngl.snapshots/tree.sngl
grep 'flow\(role="code"\)' app.sngl.snapshots/tree.sngl
grep 'text\(value="<em>not markup</em>  two spaces' app.sngl.snapshots/tree.sngl
grep 'inline\(href="https://example.com/"\)' app.sngl.snapshots/tree.sngl
grep 'inline\(kind="keyword"\)' app.sngl.snapshots/tree.sngl
grep 'fontWeight = "bold"' app.sngl.snapshots/tree.sngl
grep 'image\(src="/icon.png", alt="an icon"\)' app.sngl.snapshots/tree.sngl

# And the snapshot is stable: a second run compares against what the first
# wrote rather than writing it again.
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=
sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"
import md "sngl:ui/markup"

output { none { none } }

component main node {
    vbox {
        md.paragraph {
            md.text(value="<em>not markup</em>  two spaces\nand a newline")
            md.bold {
                md.text(value=" bold")
            }
            md.link(href="https://example.com/") {
                md.monospace {
                    md.text(value="mono link")
                }
            }
            md.image(src="/icon.png", alt="an icon")
        }
        md.codeBlock {
            md.token(kind=md.Token.keyword) {
                md.text(value="func")
            }
        }
    }
}

func testTree(t Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("tree")
}

window {
    main
}
